text:
maya (AE): Heads-up — Meridian Health wants SOC 2 artifacts, ISO summary, a signed pen-test attestation scoped to staging, and a schedule for their external scanner. Legal wants to know if the pen-test attestation can be our standard template or must be on letterhead. Also asking whether Dedicated POC pricing changes if we lock down staging CIDRs.

lucas (Security): Pen-test attestation: our typical approach is a vendor-signed attestation plus a Redwood security sign-off. For a customer-facing attestation the tester signature or company letterhead is preferred. We can issue a short-form attestation within 24h, but getting the pen-tester sig may take 2-5 business days depending on the vendor.

tess (Solutions): On artifacts: we can send an artifact index and selected control evidence (network diagram, KMS rotation logs, SOC2 type II excerpt). Meridian's ask of "everything that proves controls exist" is too broad — suggest clarifying which artifacts they need for procurement vs. for the security team.

maya (AE): I'll ask Meridian to clarify. They also want ephemeral staging IPs for an authenticated scan and a CIDR allowlist for unauthenticated scans. Any constraints?

aaron (Infra): We can provide scheduled ephemeral IPs or CIDR ranges for a scanning window. Example ephemeral: `34.201.120.45` (can be NATed) or windows of `54.152.0.0/16` for a limited timeframe. We need scan start/end, target FQDNs, and port list. If they want continuous access, that'll need a ticket and firewall rules with approval.

lucas (Security): Redaction: for POC purposes we can redact vulnerability details and provide a high-level severity summary. Legal usually wants full findings under NDA in a secured dataroom. Note: do not redact items that show critical PII exposure without consulting security.

tess (Solutions): Pricing: Dedicated pool pricing increases for single-tenant network isolation and longer log retention. Pen-test itself doesn't change the month-to-month price unless they require dedicated on-prem connectors or extended audit logging. I can model a placeholder quote: +25% for single-tenant isolation, +monthly for retention.

maya (AE): Customer deadline — procurement wants artifacts in 3 business days. Can we meet that with draft attestation?

lucas (Security): Draft artifact pack + short attestation we can assemble in 24 hours. Signed pen-tester letter is unlikely in 3 days unless the tester is ready to sign immediately. We'll mark that as dependent on tester SLA.

aaron (Infra): If they accept scheduled windows, we can arrange scan allowlist in 48 hours. If they need exact CIDRs, confirm whether they accept NATed IPs.

maya (AE): Action items: 1) @lucas drop draft attestation + artifact index within 24h; 2) @aaron propose ephemeral IPs and a scheduler runbook in 48h; 3) @tess build Dedicated pricing placeholder with isolation and retention lines. I'll ask Meridian to confirm scope (full reports vs index) and scanner details.

compliance-bot: note: SOC2 type II excerpt and ISO 27001 statement available in the internal compliance bucket. Access requires NDA or presigned link.

lucas (Security): One more note — Meridian asked if we can sign the pen-test attestation retroactively to match their scan date. We cannot backdate. Any attestation must reflect actual scan dates.

maya (AE): Got it, will relay. Thanks all — I'll update once Meridian confirms scan window and which artifacts they need. :pray:
